description: Angular component for configuring label-value card widget settings in Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and preview functionality.

classes.name: LabelValueCardWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending WidgetSettingsComponent for label-value card widget configuration.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on showLabel and showIcon toggles.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the widget's value using current configuration.
